findings.summary: The v6 source manifest omits the required committed Plan 171 summary identity and its checker cannot enforce the dual-summary closure.
Recovery proof accepts an audited filesystem import without proving its exact arity, options, or canonical target.
External namespace imports can spoof trusted global receiver names because method admission ignores namespace provenance.
Callback-object aliases can bypass recovery reachability because callback identity does not propagate through identifier arguments and parameters.
The required focused post-publication suite retains a source-only destination-absence assertion and is not green after manifest publication.
